plan: RECOVERY_MINIMAL_PLAN_V1.md (Codex R85) with Codex R86 policy ba90fd66 and R87 review fixes

trigger.kind: simulator-privileged stall trigger (NOT a deployable visual detector)
trigger.evaluated: only when a new chunk is about to be generated, from fully executed earlier chunks
trigger.full_window: complete, termination none, executed_count == inference_horizon == 32, post_obs offsets 4..32, finite fields
trigger.range: max pairwise Euclidean distance of mug_functional_point over all samples (chunk start + 4-step post_obs) of the last K full windows
trigger.phase_gate: closing-attempt proxy: right_gripper <= 0.1 at some sample of an earlier chunk; no grasp/contact claim
trigger.grip_open: right_gripper >= 0.9 at the last sample of the last chunk
trigger.not_success: official hanging_mug geometric target: |mug_fp - (rack_pose.p + rack_fp)/2|_xy < 0.02 each and mug z > 0.86
trigger.selection_note: phase gate and thresholds chosen in-sample on the 5 old G0 episodes (ep1/ep2 trigger, ep0/3/4 not); no generalisation claim

arms.B1: at a trigger the next chunk = reference proposal R (executed never) + ordinary joint candidate; candidate executed
arms.B2: same R; candidate future frames clamped at every executed denoising step to (1-s)*R_final + s*own seeded noise, frame 0 live; candidate executed

qualification.official: st_seed = 100000*(1+seed_param), expert_check, one candidate per invocation, contiguous

arm_order: per ordinal i: rotation[i % 3] with rotation = (B0,B1,B2),(B1,B2,B0),(B2,B0,B1); sealed with the manifest

M2.promotion: engineering only (complete cells, common prefix, trigger state, receipts, clamp, terminal logs, memory, ledger); recovery path must be exercised by >=1 B1 and >=1 B2 correction else engineering incomplete; never success/rescue counts

M3.primary: all-N paired official success-rate difference B2 - B1
M3.rescue: B0 failure and arm success / number of B0 failures d; d=0 -> NA; d in 1..3 reported as k/d, flagged too small for stability claims
M3.harm: B0 success and arm failure / number of B0 successes
M3.missing: not_run / incomplete cells kept in all-N tables with sensitivity; no seed replacement, no extension, no complete-case substitution
